name: Andaz One Bangkok, by Hyatt
short_description: A 244-room Andaz that opened December 2025 inside the One Bangkok complex on Wireless Road, with most rooms overlooking Lumphini Park.
ai_summary: Andaz One Bangkok opened in December 2025 inside the sprawling One Bangkok development on Wireless Road, at the corner of Rama IV Road with Lumphini MRT station at its doorstep. Around 80% of its 244 rooms overlook Lumphini Park, and early guest accounts describe immaculate, attentive service, an extensive breakfast spread, and one of the more comfortable hotel beds guests have slept in. As a newly opened property, it doesn't yet have the long review history of Bangkok's established Hyatt hotels, so its track record is still building.

faqs.question: When did Andaz One Bangkok open?
faqs.answer: It opened in December 2025 inside the One Bangkok mega-development on Wireless Road, making it one of the newest Hyatt-family hotels in the city, with a shorter guest-review history than Bangkok's established Hyatt properties.

faqs.question: Do the rooms at Andaz One Bangkok have park views?
faqs.answer: About 80% of the hotel's 244 rooms overlook Lumphini Park, Bangkok's largest central green space, which sits directly across Rama IV Road from the hotel. Guests booking a park-view category can expect uninterrupted green views rather than the city or construction views more common at other Wireless Road hotels.
